brief:
The Heavenly Culture, World Peace, Restoration of Light (HWPL) held an online Middle East peace summit bringing together peace advocates and experts to discuss regional cooperation and joint initiatives, the Palestine News Network reported. A Palestinian participant used the forum to highlight the suffering of Palestinians and called for international action to end the occupation.

The summit, which took place in Bethlehem, aimed to explore collaborative approaches to regional challenges among attendees from multiple backgrounds and expertise areas.

title: Peace advocates convene online summit on Middle East cooperation
